$comment: Fixture owner registry for the stale-content-review gate (Issue #437). The dates are absolute so the suite is deterministic: the test passes --today=2026-10-22, which puts the `current` record (2026-10-12) and the typography record (2026-10-01) inside the 90-day window and the `stale` record (2026-01-01) outside it. The unrecorded expression is deliberately absent from this list.
